title: Crypto and Ws
description: Study the implementation in [src/crypto.js] and [src/ws.js]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include generateKeyPair, toPublicKey, toPrivateKey, deriveSharedKey, sessionSalt, encryptWithCounter, decryptWithCounter, encrypt, acceptKey, encodeFrame, encodeText, parseFrame, attachWebSocket, broadcast; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in src/crypto.js, src/ws.js.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
